ablation.notes: Sinkhorn entropic-regularized OT per region. Architecture fix: _sinkhorn_1d_batched uses envelope theorem (detached duals) + projection vectorization. VRAM budget on 8GB RTX 4070: P=16, batch=12 (the [P,N,M] cost matrix retained for backward limits P). ε=0.1, iters=10.
